upcoming.title: Stand-Up Comedy with Geoff Tate
upcoming.body:
BUY TICKETS

Friday, September 18th, 2026

Admission $20+.

Showtime 7:30 | Doors Open at 6:45pm

An evening of stand-up comedy presented by D&D Comedy in conjunction with the Old Liberty Theater.

Geoff Tate tells his jokes interwoven with relatable stories as he seeks insight into his own life and maybe even yours. Geoff made his television debut on Comedy Central and has appeared on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson. He regularly tours with Tom Segura, Doug Benson and Doug Stanhope. His style has earned praise from peers, including Doug Stanhope calling him “the next Bill Burr” and Mike Birbiglia describing him as a “comedy savant”. A fixture in the comedy podcast scene, Geoff has appeared on “WTF w/ Marc Maron”, “Your Mom’s House w/ Tom Segura and Christina P”, “The BertCast”, “You Made it Weird w/ Pete Holmes”, “The Doug Stanhope Podcast”, and is a regular on “Doug Loves Movies”, as well as “Getting Doug with High”.

Guest Comedians TBD

Guests comedians subject to change. Ages 18+ recommended

Friday, October 23rd, 2026

Admission $20+.

An evening of stand-up comedy presented by D&D Comedy in conjunction with the Old Liberty Theater.

Andrew Sleighter performed on Last Comic Standing, recorded a comedy special for Dry Bar and made his late-night stand-up debut on Conan. He's also written and performed sketch comedy for Comedy Central and wrote and blogged for the Sports Show with Norm Macdonald on Comedy Central. Most recently Andrew appeared on the Late Late Show with James Corden.

A regular at colleges and comedy clubs across the country, Andrew’s also performed at some of the most prestigious comedy festivals in and out of the country including Bumbershoot, Bridgetown, Gilda’s Laugh Fest, The Aspen Comedy Festival, Laughing Skull, and the Johnny Carson Great American Comedy Festival.

Featuring guest comedian, Lance Edward

upcoming.title: Hot Rhythms: A Sinful Cabaret Burlesque Revue
upcoming.body:
BUY TICKETS

Friday, October 30th, 2026

General Admission $30.

Limited VIP Table: $150.

Showtime 7:30 | Doors Open at 6:45pm

Step into a sinful, spooky night of 1920s hot jazz and theatrical burlesque with the Ne Plus Ultra Jass Orchestra at historic Old Liberty Theater. Get ready for a sinful, spooky night of hot jazz, burlesque, and vintage glamour! The Ne Plus Ultra Jass Orchestra brings its 12-piece ensemble to the historic Old Liberty Theater in downtown Ridgefield for one night only with Hot Rhythms: A Sinful Cabaret Burlesque Revue.

Known for presenting the hottest and most authentic classic jazz of the 1920s and 1930s, the Ne Plus Ultra Jass Orchestra will take you back to the era of Prohibition with a wicked collection of ghoulish, sultry, and downright irresistible tunes.

Joining the orchestra for this special Halloween-weekend performance are acclaimed Pacific Northwest burlesque performers Natasha Riot, Cruz Daniels, and Wolfgang X. Together, the performers and musicians bring the storytelling, theatricality, and playful sensuality of classic burlesque to life, with the dancers performing alongside the live orchestra.

Expect vintage jazz. Sinful rhythms. Spooky surprises. And a night of cabaret decadence you won't soon forget.

This is a one-night-only event, so come dressed for the occasion, grab a drink, and prepare to be transported to a darker, sexier side of the Jazz Age.

Ages 21+ only

An evening of stand-up comedy presented by D&D Comedy in conjunction with the Old Liberty Theater.

Bo Johnson is a touring headliner that has been featured on multiple acclaimed comedy competitions and festivals. Fromheadlining clubs, breweries, and appropriately sized theaters across the United States and Canada. His stand-up has been featured on Netflix is a Joke Radio, season two of Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City on Comedy Central,Don’t Tell Comedy Secret Sets, & LOL Live! at the prestigious Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal. He was a finalist in the 39th annual Seattle International Comedy Competition and is a regular at festivals including Bumbershoot, SF Sketchfest, the Double Down Comedy Experience sponsored by Zappos, Life is Beautiful in Las Vegas, Rifflandia in Victoria BC, Prizefest, and Big Pine Comedy Festival in Phoenix. Bo has been the open act at theatre shows for comedians like Marc Maron, Jessica Kirson, & Dave Nihill. With a growing online audience, Bo’s jokes have been viewed millions of times online.

past.title: The Weeds: Trio of Innovative Original Irish Melodies
past.body:
BUY TICKETS

Friday, September 11th, 2026

Admission $22.

Showtime 7:30 | Doors Open at 6:45pm

The Weeds will take you on a musical journey ‘across the pond,' seamlessly blending traditional Irish melodies with innovative original compositions and arrangements. Hailing from Carmel, California, the Weeds consist of a family trio: fiddler John Weed (Molly’s Revenge/New World String Project) and his sons, Tyler Weed (mandolin, Irish tenor banjo, guitar) and Evan Weed (Celtic harp, piano, melodica).
